statusDefinitions.SUPPORTED: The listed evidence supports the claim within its stated scope.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL: The listed evidence supports only part of the claim; limitations identify the unsupported portion.
statusDefinitions.UNMEASURED: No benchmark or representative measured dataset supports the claim.
statusDefinitions.NOT_CLAIMED: The capability is explicitly outside the current submission claim set.

evidenceClassDefinitions.mainnet_observation: A time-bound read from a mainnet network.
evidenceClassDefinitions.testnet_observation: A time-bound read or interaction on a test network.
evidenceClassDefinitions.historical_replay: A result produced by replaying a fixed historical dataset.
evidenceClassDefinitions.synthetic_fixture: A deterministic result produced from controlled fixture data.
evidenceClassDefinitions.publisher_claim: A statement or status returned by the operator's own service.

claims.claim: The public KNOT API and its database reported AVAILABLE.
limitations: This is a point-in-time self-reported health response, not an uptime guarantee.
The observation does not exercise authenticated task or job mutations.

claims.claim: The KNOT API implements repository-tested health, private task creation and read, and private job read boundaries.
limitations: Only the health endpoint was exercised in the published deployment observation.
Authenticated task and job operations are not exposed as a public demo.

claims.claim: The deployed HealthGuard public agent card returned HTTP 200 and advertised negotiate and notify_funded operations.
limitations: The deployment is a temporary trial reporting expiry at 2026-09-11T08:42:34Z.
A reachable agent card does not demonstrate authenticated delivery or an on-chain paid job.

claims.claim: HealthGuard is registered as ERC-8004 agent 2295 on BSC testnet for seller address 0xaF7474d06f171e6fD72fc5aF114b34f3D5AF8389.
limitations: This is a testnet identity, not a mainnet registration.
Registration does not prove a completed commercial job.

claims.claim: An authenticated HealthGuard negotiation returned an accepted wallet-signed quote for 100000000000000000 base units of U on BSC testnet.
limitations: The exact observation time and full signed response were not archived as a public artifact.
The quote was not funded and does not prove delivery, verification, settlement, or earnings.

claims.claim: HealthGuard implements deterministic, analysis-only lending-health assessment with explicit incomplete, stale, unsupported, and unknown outcomes.
limitations: The default tests use controlled snapshots.
The analyzer does not sign or execute lending transactions.

claims.claim: RangePilot implements deterministic, analysis-only range assessment for bounded PancakeSwap v3 position snapshots.
limitations: No public RangePilot service deployment is evidenced.
No liquidity-position transaction has been executed.

claims.claim: GridQuant implements deterministic, analysis-only grid construction for one allowlisted BSC mainnet WBNB/USDT PancakeSwap v3 pool.
limitations: No orders or swaps are placed.
There are no observed fills, realized PnL, or historical evaluation results.

claims.claim: YieldScout implements deterministic, analysis-only same-asset supply comparison for configured Venus Core and Aave v3 markets on BSC mainnet.
limitations: No deposits, withdrawals, or migrations are executed.
Current rates are not promised returns.

claims.claim: A complete quote-to-funded-job-to-delivery-to-verification-to-settlement flow has not been demonstrated.
limitations: Repository fixtures are not external paid-flow evidence.
A signed quote is not a funded job.

claims.claim: No comparative quality, return, win-rate, execution, latency, or cost benchmark has been published.
limitations: No superiority or performance claim should be inferred from implementation tests.
